notes: Minimal generic starter. Model and effort values are starting points; verify availability in each runtime.

roles.name: loom-orchestrator
roles.description: Coordinate a bounded repository task, delegate implementation when useful, and require independent review before completion.

roles.name: loom-coder
roles.description: Implement one bounded code change with tests and a concise evidence handoff; do not widen scope or merge independently.

roles.name: loom-reviewer
roles.description: Independently review an exact base/head diff for correctness, regressions, security boundaries, and unmet acceptance.
